def load() -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd
    path = 'data/astronomy/input/STORM-AI/warmup/v2/Sat_Density/swarma-wu016-20140314_to_20140317.csv'
    df = pd.read_csv(path)
    # standardize columns
    df = df.rename(columns=lambda c: c.strip())
    # parse timestamp
    if 'Timestamp' in df.columns:
        df['Timestamp'] = pd.to_datetime(df['Timestamp'], errors='coerce')
    # coerce density column
    dens_col = 'Orbit Mean Density (kg/m^3)'
    if dens_col in df.columns:
        df[dens_col] = pd.to_numeric(df[dens_col], errors='coerce')
    return df

operatorProperties.code:
def load() -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd
    path = 'data/astronomy/input/STORM-AI/warmup/v2/Sat_Density/swarma-wu545-20180718_to_20180721.csv'
    df = pd.read_csv(path)
    # Standardize types
    df['Timestamp'] = pd.to_datetime(df['Timestamp'], errors='coerce', utc=True)
    col = 'Orbit Mean Density (kg/m^3)'
    df[col] = pd.to_numeric(df[col], errors='coerce')
    df = df.dropna(subset=['Timestamp', col]).sort_values('Timestamp').reset_index(drop=True)
    return df

operatorProperties.code:
def process(swarmA_2014, swarmA_2018) -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd
    col = 'Orbit Mean Density (kg/m^3)'
    peak_2014 = pd.to_numeric(swarmA_2014[col], errors='coerce').max()
    peak_2018 = pd.to_numeric(swarmA_2018[col], errors='coerce').max()
    ratio = peak_2014 / peak_2018 if peak_2018 and pd.notna(peak_2018) else float('nan')
    return pd.DataFrame([
        {'period': '2014-03-14_to_2014-03-17', 'peak_density_kg_m3': peak_2014},
        {'period': '2018-07-18_to_2018-07-21', 'peak_density_kg_m3': peak_2018},
        {'period': 'ratio_2014_over_2018', 'peak_density_kg_m3': ratio},
    ])
